title: ux-review
tagline: Reviews a screen or flow and lists usability findings with a rule, a severity and a fix.
prompt: Do a UX review of this flow: 1. Cart: a Delete link removes the item at once, with no undo. 2. Payment: after Pay the page stays the same for about 5 seconds.
outputs: Numbered usability findings with place, evidence, rule id, severity and recommendation
Open questions for what the input does not show
